note: Frozen development subset of the GPU-MODE reference-kernels problem sets pmpp_v2 and linalg. Problem files stay in the local gitignored research cache; this manifest carries ids, embedded task.yml text and sha256 bindings only. It is a selection of upstream data, not a new problem bank.

upstream.scope: problem sets pmpp_v2 + linalg only: per-problem file closure plus set-level eval.py/utils.py/template.py and problems/<set>.yaml metadata; other sets (amd*, helion, bioml, nvidia Blackwell-fp4) are out of scope and not snapshotted

protocol.name: reference-kernels-local-replica-v1
protocol.identity_rule: sha256 over canonical JSON {name, commit, problems, files{path: sha256}} where files are the set-level eval/utils/template closure plus each problem's eval.py/reference.py/task.py/validation.py and LICENSE; recomputed by the adapter and cross-checked at verify
protocol.description: Local replication of upstream per-set eval protocol: correctness via the pinned check_implementation (default utils.verbose_allclose rtol=1e-5/atol=1e-8; per-problem overrides stay pinned), inputs materialized only by the pinned generate_input, timing via CUDA events with clear_l2_cache between runs and ns duration statistics bounded by max_repeats/max_time. All local numbers are replications on hardware the official leaderboard does not list (B200/H100/A100/L4) and must never be compared with official leaderboard results. Separate from kernelbench/multikernelbench/userbench protocols.
protocol.references: see identity files; verified against the pinned snapshot at load time
